result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals at the traffic light and has parked vehicles that may obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by a traffic light, but there are no visible pedestrian signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side utility pole where traffic light is mounted

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear right-of-way information for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and traffic signals, but suffers from significant maintenance neglect. Faded crosswalk markings and the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals create a hazardous environment for crossing the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is severely worn, making it less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle lights.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street block the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to all corners.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked zebra crosswalk. However, safety is limited by faded pavement markings and parked vehicles that may obstruct sight lines at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may block the view of pedestrians for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra markings for the crosswalk are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows an urban street with multi-story residential buildings and a wide roadway divided by a concrete median. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the environment lacks marked crosswalks and exhibits significantly degraded pavement conditions.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is heavily cracked and patched, creating potential trip hazards and uneven surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the width of the street

interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and repave the street to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, safe surface for all users.
